answer: Reputation accrues as integral of stake × time: rep = Σ stake_i × (1 - decay)^(epochs_elapsed). New identity starts at 0, needs 5 epochs to reach voting threshold 90. Attacker with N identities must maintain N × 1000 stake for 5 epochs, opportunity cost = N × 1000 × APY × 5/365. Verification: on-chain stake snapshots each epoch, reputation updated via Merkle root. Sybil cost grows superlinearly due to decay compounding. Words: dune, echo, reef.
